composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. creative_direction: Create a timber pergola at the edge of a small orchard. Keep the pergola beams below the upper fifth, with sparse vines rather than a dense canopy. Three small orchard trees create layered depth, their trunks framing the path. Render warm timber grain, a few fallen leaves, and soft patterned shadows. No fruit baskets, people, or signs interrupt the quiet scene. Use naturalistic garden environment art. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
